widgets_values:
# H3 All In One

One workflow for every MiniMax H3 job. It combines **h3_master, h3_director, ai_influencer, product_ad_studio** and the H3 part of **talking_head_narration**. Defaults are the highest quality.

## Main settings
- **QUALITY**: 1 = low (fast turbo draft), 2 = medium (full model, 20 steps), 3 = high (full model, 40 steps).
- **RESOLUTION**: 480, 720 or 1080. **VERTICAL** on = 9:16, off = 16:9.
- **DURATION**: any length from 3 to 15 seconds.
- **AUDIO**: on = video with sound, off = silent video.
- **REFERENCE MODE**: on = a new scene built from your references. Off = animates the FIRST FRAME exactly as it is (or text-only with no image).
- FAST ATTENTION is off for normal speed and best quality.

## What to fill in for each kind of video
**Character / influencer from references (h3_director)**
REFERENCE MODE on. Fill CHARACTER 1 (and 2, 3, OUTFIT, BACKGROUND, PROP, MOTION VIDEO, VOICE SAMPLE as needed). Write "the main character", "the background" and so on in the prompt.

**Animate one image (ai_influencer, h3_master first-frame mode)**
REFERENCE MODE off. Fill FIRST FRAME. Optional LAST FRAME. Turn on SHARPEN FIRST FRAME if the image is small or soft.

**Product ad (product_ad_studio)**
REFERENCE MODE off. Put the product photo in KEYFRAME BUILDER: PRODUCT / SUBJECT IMAGE. Turn on BUILD OPENING FRAME and BUILD END FRAME. Qwen Image Edit makes a styled opening shot and a closer end shot with the same label, and H3 animates from one to the other. Describe one camera move in the prompt.

**Talking head (talking_head_narration)**
REFERENCE MODE off. FIRST FRAME = the portrait (face large and sharp). VOICE TRACK = your voice file. The lips follow it. Turn on KEEP ORIGINAL VOICE to save your exact audio in the video. In the prompt describe the delivery, not the words.

## Extra switches
- **SHARPEN FIRST FRAME**: cleans up a small or soft first frame with SeedVR2. Only when a first frame is given.
- **KEEP ORIGINAL VOICE**: only with a VOICE TRACK.
- **UPSCALE VIDEO**: SeedVR2 upscale to the UPSCALE short edge. Slow. Off = native size.

## Good to know
- Empty slots are skipped. Image and video slots have an upload button. For audio slots, copy the file into ComfyUI/input and press R.
- 1080 is above the size H3 was trained on (768) and is much slower.
- 5-6 s clips hold best. Longer clips drift more and take much longer.
- Prompt: "Locked camera, no cuts, no zoom." for a steady shot. Speech in quotes after "Audio:". Add "no text on screen".
- Not included: the Wan 2.2 long-form engine (voices longer than 15 s). That stays in talking_head_narration.
